newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Winds sweep Kansas, Oklahoma.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Winds sweep Kansas, Oklahoma.

text.p: High winds swept through Kansas and Oklahoma, causing soil movement in areas with low moisture levels, grain merchandisers said Tuesday.

"We saw gusts above 40 miles per hour -- topsoil was moving like crazy," one dealer in north central Oklahoma said. "We're pretty dry and we need a real soaking. They're saying there's a pretty good chance of rain tomorrow for the whole (of Oklahoma)."
Dealers said southwest Kansas also saw high winds Monday, but dealers in the northwest part of the state said winds were mostly light.
Basis bids were mostly unchanged, although one Oklahoma merchandiser rolled its bid out to be calculated against the KCBT May wheat contract instead of the March contract.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: H=KCBT March wheat futures. K=KCBT May wheat futures. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
